split_why: The split stays at five and three because it already matches the flights (in through Krabi, home from Bangkok after the countdown), and Krabi now needs only two outings off Railay.
monkeys_note: You stay on Railay, where shy dusky leaf monkeys and some long-tailed macaques use Phra Nang beach and the path beside Rayavadee, so keep villa doors shut and never leave food or bags on the sand. The plan skips the Princess Lagoon trail, Phi Phi’s Monkey Beach, Tiger Cave Temple and the monkey cave that rafting tours often add; Bangkok has none.

route: Mui Ne 3 days, Ho Chi Minh City 5 days
split_why: The split stays the same because the two drives are needed either way, and Ho Chi Minh City holds New Year’s Eve, New Year’s Day and the flight home, so moving days would only cut beach time.
monkeys_note: None of the places in this plan are known for monkeys. Ta Cu Mountain and Can Gio’s Monkey Island have them, so both are left out.

split_why: Kept at four and four because every split needs the same two domestic flights, Day 1 is mostly travel so Langkawi needs four days to give three usable ones, and Kuala Lumpur has to hold New Year’s Eve and the flight home.
monkeys_note: No monkey hotspot is visited, but the Ritz-Carlton itself has frequent long-tailed macaques and dusky leaf monkeys, sometimes on balconies, so keep doors shut and leave no food outside. A few macaques also visit the SkyCab top-station café, so keep snacks packed away and take the SkyGlide lift.

split_why: Kept at three and five days: the Coron resort covers the beach day without extra travel, a 40-minute flight replaces the long ferry, and El Nido’s land activities are all short drives from Seda Lio.
monkeys_note: Long-tailed macaques are sometimes seen on Miniloc Island, where the Big and Small Lagoons are, so stay in the kayak and keep food sealed on the boat. The plan drops Tour C, whose Matinloc Shrine stop has monkeys; no monkeys are reported at the Coron resort, Mount Tapyas, Taraw Cliff, Las Cabanas or Nacpan.

reason: Little variety without water activities: no karting or rafting, and most highlights are boat or snorkel trips
split_why: Without snorkelling, diving and repeated boat trips, Maafushi has about four distinct days, so one night moves to the resort, which also cuts mosquito exposure on the local island and adds the resort’s free festive events, at a higher cost.
monkeys_note: There are no monkeys anywhere in the Maldives; the only wildlife in this plan is dolphins seen from a boat.
Red colobus monkeys in Jozani Forest, which you can skip, and Sykes’ monkeys in some beach-hotel gardens. Stone Town has none.
Toque macaques and langurs are common in south-coast gardens, on hotel roofs and along the Bentota river.

reason: Mostly romantic, too few activities, shopping no different from Egypt
monkeys_note: Long-tailed macaques live in the forests and gorges and sometimes visit hotel gardens near them; beach areas see few.

reason: Not your style; replaced by the southern Vietnam route
monkeys_note: Few wild monkeys; mostly at the safari park, which you can skip.
